detail.en: The National Cyber Crime Helpline for financial fraud. Read the call script below, top to bottom, and ask for the complaint reference number.

title.hi: अपने बैंक को सूचित करें और ब्लॉक करवाएँ

detail.en: Use the number on your card or the bank's app. Report the unauthorised transaction, ask them to block cards/UPI/net-banking as needed, and note the complaint number.
Don't delete chats, call logs, SMS or the app. Screenshot every transaction page and the scammer's number, profile and links.

title.en: File the formal complaint within 24 hours
title.hi: 24 घंटे के भीतर औपचारिक शिकायत दर्ज करें

detail.en: On cybercrime.gov.in, using the complaint text below. After your 1930 call you receive an SMS with a reference number and a link to the portal.
Change passwords and UPI PIN. If you installed an APK or screen-share app, uninstall it and check your other bank accounts and apps.
Anyone who contacts you promising to recover your money for a fee is very likely a second scam.
Track the complaint on cybercrime.gov.in and keep printouts to take to your bank branch or cyber cell.
